opening.argument: The material presents a Forsage-related meeting as an online earning opportunity and promotes the associated business. Its title describes a “FORSAGE MEETING” and “HUGE INCOME,” while the displayed meeting scene identifies a “WELCOME FORSAGE” and “online earning platform.” The speaker also gives a promotional shout-out to “Cryptobase Network Marketing” and describes the business as available “from anywhere and in any corner!” These facts establish a commercial promotion, but the available material does not specify an upfront payment, request private information, identify a destination for funds, or establish that the income claims are deceptive. The promotion is therefore insufficiently specific to support a scam conclusion.
